why_agent_cannot: nothing - the domain is dead or looks like a scam
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://faucet-testnet.kryvora.network   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: Add the network to an EVM wallet such as MetaMask or Rabby, with these settings: Network name: Kryvora Network
Open the Kryvora faucet , paste your address and pass the check. It sends 0.001 test ETH, once every 24 hours per wallet and IP address.

Open the task portal , connect the wallet and sign the login message. Then claim the three setup quests: Connect Your Wallet (100 points), Add Kryvora to Your Wallet (150) and Get ETH from the Faucet (250).
Make any transaction on Kryvora, such as a transfer or a swap, and claim Make a Kryvora Transaction (300). The portal checks your activity from the last 24 hours.
On Kryvora DApps , swap ETH for one of the test tokens, KALPHA or KBETA. Then add liquidity to a pool and submit the transaction hash in the portal for Provide Liquidity on Kryvora DEX (500).
On Kryvora Lending , press "Mint Test Tokens", supply collateral (400) and borrow against it (450). Submit both transaction hashes in the portal.
If you know how to deploy a contract, deploy one on chain 73829164 with Remix, Hardhat or Foundry (500) and verify it on the explorer (600). Explore Blockscout Telemetry adds 350.
Optional: bridge Sepolia ETH to Kryvora on the DApps bridge page (400). You need Sepolia ETH from a Sepolia faucet first, and the deposit waits for six confirmations.
